text:
Eli (Product): quick checkin. Beacon asked for an onramp that guarantees cold-start p99 < 300ms, tenant isolation (per-tenant namespaces), and BYOK. we need a sequencing plan across product/runtime/infra/security. who sees the longest lead?
Nina (PM): timeline ask: pilot in 5w. acceptance: p99 target, successful BYOK rotation test, and staging smoke with 10k tokens/day.
Sam (Runtime): runtime pieces: prewarm API (signal before tenant traffic), namespace isolation for KV caches, and metric tags for tenant id. prewarm requires infra to signal GPU nodes.
Carlos (Infra): infra needs vpc peering + subnet provisioning + cloud account quotas. quota bump for reserved GPUs can be 7-10bd. peering + routing rules ~3bd after security signoff.
Maya (Security): BYOK is the gating item. need vendor KMS docs, key attestation, and an IAM matrix. estimate: 8 business days to complete review once we have vendor packet. also need egress allowlist for KMS endpoints.
Priya (Eng): engineering effort: feature-flagged per-tenant namespaces + automated tests. approx 2.5w. can parallelize with runtime once infra has mock endpoints.
Leo (SRE): we need tenant-level SLOs, and canary policy: start with 2% traffic, monitor p50/p95/p99, auto-shift on error. also require synthetic probe for cold-start every 4h.
Eli (Product): sounds like critical path = security packet -> quota approvals -> runtime integration. can we overlap security review with eng spiking feature flags?
Maya (Security): yes, but we can't approve peering or KMS creds until attestation is done. reviews can run in parallel with spiking.
Sam (Runtime): i'll sketch a prewarm handshake this afternoon. will include a health endpoint: ```GET /tenant/{id}/prewarm_status -> {"warm": true|false, "kv_prefetch": "done|in_progress"}``` for routing.
Priya (Eng): will wire the feature flag and tests against a mocked health endpoint. posting a short RFC by EOD.
Carlos (Infra): i'll open quota request and a peering ticket now. tagging for cloud-ops. also need expected CIDR ranges from Beacon.
Nina (PM): Beacon to provide CIDR + KMS vendor by tomorrow. i've asked them to send vendor attestation pack.
Leo (SRE): can we agree on an automatic fallback? proposal: if tenant p99 > 300ms for 10m, route that tenant to hosted fallback for 30m and alert.
Sam (Runtime): fallback routing is doable. will add a quick health check that returns cache warm percentage so routing can be smarter.
Eli (Product): action items: 1) Maya: start attestation review once vendor packet in (due 8bd). 2) Carlos: quota + peering tickets (due 3bd). 3) Sam/Priya: mock prewarm + feature-flag RFC (deliverable: RFC link by EOW). 4) Leo: canary + fallback policy draft (2bd). 5) Nina/Eli: acceptance checklist with token volumes and runbook (2bd). please ack with :white_check_mark:.
ticket-bot: Created ticket: INFRA-ACME-ONRAMP-278 by Carlos.
Carlos (Infra): ticket created and linked to this thread.
Priya (Eng): RFC posted: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/tenant-namespaces-mvp (has tests + rollout plan).
Sam (Runtime): noted RFC, adding prewarm handshake details and KV isolation plan.
Maya (Security): received vendor packet from Beacon. starting initial review now.
Nina (PM): quick risk callout: if vendor attestation shows missing SOC docs, that will push timeline by >2w.
Eli (Product): noted. if that happens we'll propose a limited hosted BYOK shim as fallback.
Leo (SRE): I'll add synthetic probe and alert runbook stub to the SRE playbook. posting link tomorrow.
Eli (Product): thanks all. next sync Tues 9am to check blockers. react :white_check_mark: when you saw your action.
